# GC Wallet development

Read [Active Context](../docs/ACTIVE_CONTEXT.md) first and follow
[AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md). GitHub is the sole durable project authority.
Use [Architecture](../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md), [M3 decisions](../docs/M3_DESIGN_DECISIONS.md),
[Roadmap](../docs/ROADMAP.md) and [QA](../docs/QA_TEST_CHECKLIST.md) for their contracts.

GPT retains architecture, roadmap and independent assessment responsibilities.
